intro: Kaal Soulreaper is an orc warlock trainer stationed deep within the Magic Quarter of the Undercity. Despite dwelling among the Forsaken, he maintains close ties to fellow practitioners of the dark arts across the Horde, frequently guiding apprentices to mentors in distant lands.

p: While Thrall's Horde strictly regulates and monitors fel magic within Orgrimmar, practitioners like Kaal Soulreaper find ample harbor in the subterranean sanctums of Lordaeron. Residing within the Magic Quarter of the Undercity, Kaal shares his mastery over demonic entities and curses with Horde warlocks willing to learn. Beyond basic instruction, he acts as an essential contact for practitioners seeking greater power, directing ambitious students across the sea to mentors like Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.
